annotations.title: Get the organization's usage across all numbers

description:
Get WhatsApp message and contact usage for the whole organization.

The top-level totals are the **sum across every live number**: when each
of two numbers has a quota of 1,000 messages, the organization reports
2,000, not 1,000. The `numbers[]` breakdown shows each number
separately, which is what you need to find the one that is close to its
own ceiling, so a healthy-looking total can hide a number at 99%.

For one number, `get_message_quota` and `get_contact_quota` are more
direct.

The answer also says how long message text is kept.
`content_retention_hours` is how many hours it is kept now: read it to
tell a person how far back message text can be read, since after that a
message is still listed, with `content_expired` set and its content
empty. `content_retention_max_hours` is the plan maximum of the account,
and `longer_retention_on_other_plans` says whether other plans keep text
longer (both are absent when they cannot be determined).
`content_retention_settings_url` is where the person changes the window,
in the privacy settings, and `plans_info_url` is an informational page
about how long text is kept.
name: get_usage
title: Get the organization's usage across all numbers
